# Demographics 

## Contra Costa County Demographic Quick Facts

View Contra Costa County's Profile

### 2025 Population Estimate: 1,158,225

- Unincorporated Contra Costa County Estimate: 175,917

source: State of California Department of Finance, E-1 Population Estimates for Cities, County and the State

Learn more at the Department of Finance Population Estimate website

### 2023 American Community Survey 5-Year Estimates (2019-2023)

The US Census Bureau's American Community Survey (ACS) data is published every year and provides socio-economic data such as, income, poverty, education, marital status, health insurance coverage and disability. The data is provided as a 5-year average for most geographic areas and also as 1-year estimates for California, Counties, and Places with a population over 65,000.

The California Department of Finance provides a summary of the ACS data for California counties and places. View selected data

### 2020 Decennial Census Count

On August 12, 2021 the Census Bureau released the first local level 2020 Census data. Initial analysis is provided below. The State Department of Finance has additional detailed tables available.

- Visit the State Department of Finance Census 2020 webpage.
- Data Profile for all Cities, Towns, and Unincorporated Census Designated Places (PDF)

### 2020 County Population: 1,165,927

Contra Costa County saw an increase of 116,902 people (10% increase) Source: 2020 Decennial Census
